what_they_do.value: Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win; its Revenue AI unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside revenue teams.

priorities.priority: Move revenue teams from insight to action and deploy AI agents at scale.
priorities.evidence: At Celebrate '26, Gong announced Gong Activate, described as the next generation of Revenue AI, with agents and reps working from the same blueprint; CEO Amit Bendov said the focus is faster cycles, higher win rates, and proven plays instead of guessing.

priorities.priority: Improve the quality and completeness of revenue context through first- and third-party data enrichment.
priorities.evidence: Mission Callisto launched Gong Enrich to expand the Gong Revenue Graph with third-party account and contact data, fill missing details, and make the context behind revenue decisions more complete.

priorities.priority: Automate repeatable revenue workflows and make complex analysis self-service.
priorities.evidence: Mission Callisto introduced automatically triggered Custom Agents through Agent Builder and Deep Mode in Gong Assistant, which investigates complex business questions and creates grounded reports instead of requiring hours of manual research.

priorities.priority: Create a single, consistent measurement layer across the revenue lifecycle.
priorities.evidence: Gong Dashboards expanded beyond forecasting so RevOps can define metrics once in Data Studio and reuse them across views, allowing sales, marketing, and customer success to work from the same numbers.

priorities.priority: Operationalize customer AI adoption and prove measurable business impact.
priorities.evidence: When Simon Frey became Chief Customer Officer, Gong said it was creating a unified Customer Office, expanding Services and Consulting fivefold, and adding Revenue Architects to help customers turn agentic-AI experimentation into measurable outcomes.

challenges.challenge: Revenue data is fragmented and account/contact records can be incomplete or outdated.
challenges.evidence: Gong says RevOps teams are stitching information together from multiple providers, while sellers spend time researching contacts and validating account records; a Sprout Social customer cited high bounce rates and outdated CRM data as workflow drag.

challenges.challenge: Many enterprises are experimenting with agentic AI but struggling to convert pilots into measurable business impact.
challenges.evidence: Gong's incoming Chief Customer Officer said many teams are still struggling to turn early agentic-AI experimentation into real business impact, making operationalization and outcome measurement a central customer issue.

challenges.challenge: Complex revenue questions and repeatable processes still consume substantial manual effort.
challenges.evidence: Gong describes repeatable processes as dependent on people to keep them moving and says complex business questions previously required hours of manual investigation across systems.

challenges.challenge: Revenue organizations lose time and alignment when performance metrics are defined inconsistently across teams and reports.
challenges.evidence: Gong says the problem was not a shortage of metrics but the effort required to define them consistently and the time lost getting from a KPI to its reason; its Dashboards product is positioned to remove that effort.

recent_changes.headline: Gong named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Revenue Action Orchestration for the second consecutive year
recent_changes.summary: Gong said it was one of four Leaders among 13 vendors and was positioned highest for Ability to Execute and furthest for Completeness of Vision.

recent_changes.headline: Mission Callisto launched with Gong Enrich, Deep Mode, Agent Builder, and expanded Gong Dashboards
recent_changes.summary: The launch adds third-party account/contact enrichment, complex-question investigation, event-triggered Custom Agents, and lifecycle-wide performance measurement.

recent_changes.headline: Gong debuted Gong Activate and additional Revenue AI innovations at Celebrate '26
recent_changes.summary: Gong announced Gong Activate plus Gong Enrich, Agent Builder, and Deep Mode, framing the strategy as a self-improving revenue loop that converts institutional knowledge into action.

key_people.name: Amit Bendov
key_people.title: Co-founder and Chief Executive Officer
key_people.recent: Announced Gong Activate at Celebrate '26 and said Gong is moving from AI telling teams how to win to AI winning deals for them; he also reiterated the insight-to-action-to-results strategy after the Gartner recognition.

key_people.name: Eilon Reshef
key_people.title: Co-founder and Chief Product Officer
key_people.recent: Introduced Mission Callisto's product rationale, saying Gong Enrich extends context beyond conversations so assistants answer more sharply, agents act more reliably, and dashboards use trusted numbers.

key_people.name: Simon Frey
key_people.title: Chief Customer Officer
key_people.recent: Was appointed to lead global customer strategy and said Gong's focus is helping customers operationalize the Revenue AI OS and drive measurable outcomes rather than remain in early experimentation.

key_people.name: Shane Evans
key_people.title: Chief Revenue Architect
key_people.recent: Said layering AI onto old workflows is not enough and that enterprises want a foundational system that improves productivity and drives sustainable growth at scale.

talking_points: Gong Activate is intended to move customers from insight to action—what measurable revenue outcomes will determine whether the self-improving revenue loop is working?
Mission Callisto addresses fragmented and stale account data—where are data quality, enrichment-provider orchestration, or CRM adoption still limiting execution?
With Gong investing in a unified Customer Office and Revenue Architects, how is Gong helping customers turn agentic-AI pilots into durable workflows and provable ROI?

input: Prepare me for a meeting with Gong (gong.io)
